We need to determine number of methyl (CH3) groups in the sample's molecule. We have no direct description of molecule. We can get NMR spectra to infer. Likely need to get 1H NMR to see number of methyl signals. But we need count of CH3 groups, not signals (could be overlapping). Could also get carbon NMR to see number of methyl carbons (around 10-30 ppm). Use carbon_nmr_spectra tool. Then count distinct methyl carbon signals. However overlapping may cause less signals. But question likely expects count based on actual molecule known to us? No description given. So we must infer from NMR data.

We can request carbon NMR.
